lines: d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Chen OBrien is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d40: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d40: 🕯️ Chen is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d40: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d40: 🕯️ Chen OBrien is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d40: What Chen kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d40: "Chen's gone." Opondo looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Chen." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d40: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Luna blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Tireless Stride (Level 1). You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d40: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Chen OBrien, 40 days. The mantle passes to Luna Vogel.
d40: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Luna Vogel, 35 — a bike messenger. Their hands know different work now: Night Eyes, Lucky Rock, Echo Location.
d40: The village's quarrel was with Chen — and Chen is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d40: At the grave, Luz, Kurt, Opondo and 5 more speak for Luna — "Chen trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d40: The fire knew Luna before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
